presets.title: Check Live Link assets before a capture session
presets.summary: Identity snapshot and validation of the selected Live Link assets: class, on disk, saved and complete, with what to fix before the session.
presets.prompt:
Check the Live Link assets {{selected_assets}} before {{session}}, and change nothing. If the live_production pack is unavailable, say so and stop.
1. hyper_capability_report: confirm the live_production pack is live.
2. hyper_live_production_inspect with familyId livelink and targetPaths the exact /Game object paths of {{selected_assets}}. Load any that answer target_not_loaded with Epic's load_asset and inspect again; page with the cursor until done.
3. hyper_live_production_validate with policy identity_snapshot and the snapshot the inspect returned.
4. These tools check identity and saved state only, not live connections or subjects: say so in the report.
Reply with a PASS/FAIL table, one row per asset: class matches the livelink family, exists on disk, saved (not dirty), persisted identity complete, validator errors and warnings. Then what to fix before {{session}}.

presets.title: Run a pre-show check of Remote Control and DMX assets
presets.summary: Find, inspect and validate the folder's Remote Control presets and DMX libraries, record the show's baseline and give a GO or NO-GO.
presets.prompt:
Run a pre-show check of the Remote Control presets and DMX libraries under {{content_folder}} for {{show}}, and change nothing. If the live_production pack is unavailable, say so and stop.
1. hyper_memory_recall `show assets` for this production's asset list and conventions.
2. hyper_project_search with kinds [asset] for Remote Control presets and DMX libraries under {{content_folder}}. Load each with Epic's load_asset, since inspect reads loaded assets only.
3. hyper_live_production_inspect once with familyId remote_control and once with familyId dmx, each with its targetPaths; page with the cursor.
4. hyper_live_production_validate with policy identity_snapshot on each returned snapshot.
5. If memory had no baseline, hyper_memory_remember the checked asset list as the baseline for {{show}}.
Reply with GO or NO-GO for {{show}} on the first line, then a PASS/FAIL table, one row per asset: family class matched, on disk, saved, identity complete, validator issues, and any asset missing against the baseline. Say plainly that live connections and DMX output are not tested.

presets.title: Preflight an nDisplay cluster change without applying it
presets.summary: Write the current and desired node and viewport layout, validate both, and dry-run the change plan for its hash and effects.

placeholders.name: current_nodes
placeholders.label: Current nodes
placeholders.hint: id, host address, and primary for exactly one node

placeholders.name: desired_nodes
placeholders.label: Desired nodes
placeholders.hint: id, host address, and primary for exactly one node

presets.prompt:
Preflight an nDisplay cluster change on {{selected_asset}} without applying it: from `{{current_nodes}}` to `{{desired_nodes}}`, each node with one viewport of {{viewport}}. If the live_production pack is unavailable, say so and stop.
1. hyper_live_production_inspect with familyId ndisplay and targetPaths [{{selected_asset}}]; keep the snapshot's persistedFingerprint.
2. Write both topologies from those lists: nodes sorted by nodeId (case-sensitive), each with an explicit hostAddress and exactly one bPrimary; one viewport per node, sorted by nodeId then viewportId, x and y from 0, positive width and height.
3. hyper_live_production_validate with policy ndisplay_topology for each topology: 0 errors; fix any ordering, primary count or region it names.
4. hyper_live_production_apply_plan with bDryRun true, targetPath {{selected_asset}}, expectedPersistedFingerprint, baseTopology and desiredTopology. Do not submit a non-dry run: this pack only preflights, and the change itself is made in the nDisplay editor.
Reply with a PASS/FAIL table: both topologies valid with their fingerprints; the plan's status, planHash and effects (node and viewport counts, physical effects). Then a short diff of the nodes and viewports added, changed or removed.

presets.title: Check broadcast graphics assets before going on air
presets.summary: Identity snapshots and validation for Motion Design, Text 3D, SVG and media assets in the folder, with counts and a ready-for-air line.
presets.prompt:
Check the broadcast graphics under {{content_folder}} before {{program}} goes on air: Motion Design (Avalanche) scenes, Text 3D, SVG and media assets. Change nothing. If the live_production pack is unavailable, say so and stop.
1. hyper_capability_report: confirm the live_production pack is live.
2. hyper_project_search with kinds [asset] under {{content_folder}} for each family's assets, and load them with Epic's load_asset.
3. hyper_live_production_inspect per family (familyId avalanche, text3d, svg and media) with those targetPaths; page with the cursor. Skip a family whose plugin is off and say so.
4. hyper_live_production_validate with policy identity_snapshot on each snapshot.
Reply with a PASS/FAIL table, one row per asset: family, class matched, on disk, saved, identity complete, issues. Then counts per family and a ready-for-air line for {{program}}. Say plainly that playback, text content and media sources are not checked by these tools.
